figures.name: quality-transitions
figures.title: Replay capacity and fixed-budget Cartpole quality
figures.caption: Faint solid/dashed curves retain seeds 0/1; bold means and shading show two-seed observed ranges, not confidence intervals. In the transition plot, the dotted vertical marker is 10 million insertions; the large buffer first fills in iteration 611. Early failures stay failed; survival alone is not balancing.

figures.name: quality-training_process_seconds
figures.title: Replay capacity and fixed-budget Cartpole quality
figures.caption: Faint solid/dashed curves retain seeds 0/1; bold means and shading show two-seed observed ranges, not confidence intervals. Wall curves use actual portable policy write-finished times, not online success detection. Early failures stay failed; survival alone is not balancing.

figures.name: execution-cost
figures.title: Execution and storage cost, independent of quality
figures.caption: Bars are means and whiskers observed ranges over both seeds. Full replay export is nested in checkpoint/loop/process cost, never added twice. Installation/upload are excluded; chronological shared caches are not independent cold starts.
